required_slots.description: State when the canopy sides should be rotated.

required_slots.name: rotated_closed_canopy_sides
required_slots.description: State which two sides should be closed after rotation.
required_slots.expected_answer: Close the north and east sides after the rotation.

optional_slots.name: wind_direction_change_explanation
optional_slots.description: May explain why the rotation occurs at 4:00 PM.
optional_slots.expected_answer: The incoming wind changes from west to north at 4:00 PM.

reference_answer.text: Close the west and north sides at 2 PM. At 4 PM, rotate to close the north and east sides, because that is when the incoming wind changes from west to north.

required_slots.name: earliest_two_load_finish
required_slots.description: State the earliest time both laundry loads can finish drying.

optional_slots.name: drying_schedule
optional_slots.description: May provide a schedule that attains the earliest finish and explain the unusable gap.
optional_slots.expected_answer: Dry one load from 9:30 to 11:00 AM and the other from noon to 1:30 PM; the intervening humidity and rain prevent an earlier second slot.

reference_answer.text: The earliest finish is 1:30 PM. Dry the first load from 9:30 to 11:00, then the second from noon to 1:30 PM; the rain and humidity between those windows prevent an earlier second slot.

required_slots.name: segments_exceeding_crosswind_limit
required_slots.description: Identify the route segments that exceed the user's crosswind-component limit.

required_slots.name: total_excess_crosswind_duration
required_slots.description: State the total duration for which the limit is exceeded.

optional_slots.name: crosswind_component_calculation
optional_slots.description: May explain the computed crosswind components and threshold comparison.
optional_slots.expected_answer: The perpendicular components are 28, 36, and 34 kph; only the latter two exceed the 32 kph limit.

reference_answer.text: The Canal climb and Levee return exceed your crosswind-component limit, for two hours total. In all three intervals the wind is perpendicular to travel, so each crosswind component equals the full gust: 28, 36, and 34 kph respectively. Only the latter two exceed 32 kph.

required_slots.name: summit_and_upper_descent_precipitation

required_slots.expected_answer: The summit stop and upper descent encounter snow.

required_slots.name: lower_descent_precipitation
required_slots.description: State the precipitation encountered on the lower descent.

optional_slots.name: hike_precipitation_timing
optional_slots.description: May state the overlap times, return time, and dry section.
optional_slots.expected_answer: The ridge climb meets rain from 9:00–10:00 AM, summit stop and upper descent meet snow from 10:10–11:50 AM, lower descent meets rain from noon–1:30 PM, and the lower approach stays dry; return is 1:30 PM.

reference_answer.text: Starting at 7:00 AM, you finish at 1:30 PM. The ridge climb meets rain from 9:00 to 10:00 AM. The summit stop and upper descent meet snow from 10:10 to 11:50 AM. The lower descent meets rain from noon until you return at 1:30 PM. The lower approach stays dry.

required_slots.name: passes_requiring_chains
required_slots.description: Identify the mountain passes where chains are required during the planned drive.

optional_slots.name: chain_requirement_overlap_detail
optional_slots.description: May explain the overlap windows and why Cloud Notch does not require chains.
optional_slots.expected_answer: Pine Pass overlaps until 8:00 AM, Eagle Gap overlaps from 9:45 to 9:50 AM, and Cloud Notch is cleared before its noon requirement begins.

reference_answer.text: You will need chains at Pine Pass and Eagle Gap. Pine Pass overlaps the requirement until 8:00 AM, and Eagle Gap overlaps from 9:45 to 9:50. You should clear Cloud Notch before its noon requirement begins.

required_slots.name: targets_with_sufficient_clear_window
required_slots.description: Identify the saved targets that have a sufficiently long clear window at the nearest observatory.

optional_slots.name: clear_window_and_orion_explanation
optional_slots.description: May state the clear windows and explain why Orion does not qualify.
optional_slots.expected_answer: There are clear 60-minute windows from 8:00–9:00 PM and 9:30–10:30 PM; Orion requires 90 continuous minutes, which is unavailable.

reference_answer.text: Saturn and the Andromeda Galaxy still have long enough clear windows. There is a 60-minute clear stretch from 8:00 to 9:00 PM, and another from 9:30 to 10:30 PM. Orion needs 90 continuous minutes, which is not available.
